name: BACH_0277_FSIM_blur3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (77%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Blur flags input reliability (33%) [F6], keeps Normal (22%) in the conformal set [F1], and prompts margin deferral [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 77%, Normal 22%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% | Favors Benign; near-zero invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90% dataset coverage) | Cannot separate Benign from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 33% (flagged, blur 3) / 78th percentile | Suspect blurred input; reduced trust |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models split |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Benign (20%), 4/5 Normal [F5] | Reference neighbors mostly Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.52 contribution) pushes away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.26 contribution) nudges toward invasion [F3] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Typical level (+0.16 contribution); descriptive context only [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.15 contribution), but 3/20 AI spot-check fails · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.15 contribution); contrasts with Normal BACH_0129 · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (95% CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 blur on this simulated frozen section masks atypia; drafted orders recommend a recut and deeper levels.
- True diagnosis is Normal (22%), matching 4/5 reference neighbors (87%–88% similarity) and the conformal set.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 8, 11**: Only regions with non-zero risk (0.003); check stroma (7) and lateral margin (24%).
2. **Regions 1, 4**: Check ductal atypia in 1 (superior margin 19%) and lymphoid infiltrate in 4.
3. **Regions 6, 9**: Compare nuclear pleomorphism (9) and benign stroma (6) to exclude Normal (BACH_0129).
